status: REPORTED DIAGNOSTICS: none is a gate or enters any score

optimizers.rule: EV4's fixed decision rules: exhaustive over the 35-point grid, the contract's tie rule and abstention (quiz.q3_judge)
random-restart local search over the continuous design box (c1 0.5-2.0 C, c2 0.2-1.0 C) on the model's own predictions, 8 restarts, the pick snapped to the nearest grid point for judging; seeds 0-4

a_optimizer_stability.report: per member: the share of Q3 scenarios where OPT-A and OPT-B (each seed) pick the same grid point; the spread of the Q3 false-feasible and regret verdicts across optimizers and seeds

b_grid_resolution.scope: public stand-in only (EV4 verification scenarios with a feasible design)
b_grid_resolution.refined_grid: c1 and c2 at 0.125 C steps over the same box (13 x 9 = 117 points)
b_grid_resolution.report: per member: whether the model's pick (model-only, no reference) moves to a different coarse cell; on 2 scenarios, whether the reference verdict changes (about 234 public host solves, inside existing approvals, scheduled with the executor)

c_power_by_k.report: detection AUC of the v5/v6 known-bad sets against the good set, mean and 5th percentile over draws (quiz-registry-v5/v6 method)

d_agreement_with_decision_value.report: Kendall tau-b and Spearman rho, with the one-seed-per-recipe band, between members' Q3 regret on the quiz scenarios and their ev4-dev-tuning-v1 development decision value

lattice_ruling: Test Lead 2026-10-07, before any tuning-set scoring: Q3 uses the 117-point lattice (quiz.q3_candidates) for tuning-v2 and the quiz batches; registry v4's leg q and diagnostics (a), (c), (d) are computed on it. (b) stays as the evidence for the change.
